role: WorkoutRecoveryService extension that copies user-entered and non-recomputable fields from the archived copy of a workout into a session rebuilt from backups (trim, recover-from-strap, recover-route-from-Watch), so the rebuild does not lose tags/notes/feeling/HRR/weather/power or the Apple Health export stamp.
types: WorkoutRecoveryService: extension — carryForward and its field-group helpers

units.does: Copies session-level fields, then (if both copies have workout metadata) user fields always, measured and power fields only when the rebuild covers the same start/end (±1 s), samples when the start is unchanged; restores partialDataReason and recoveredAt from the archived copy; writes the merged metadata back to `session`. Called by WorkoutRecoveryService.carryArchived, which then rebuilds the analysis snapshot over the carried samples.

branches.cond: archived or rebuilt session has no workoutMetadata
branches.effect: returns after copying only session-level fields (tags, notes, export stamp, …)

branches.cond: rebuild covers the same time span (coversSameTime)
branches.effect: true: carries HRR/markers/laps/strokes and power figures where the rebuild has none; false (trimmed): those are left to whatever the rebuild computed

units.does: Overwrites the rebuilt session's tags, notes, deviceProvenance, linkedSessionIds, aiContext, perceivedReadiness, morningFeeling(+tags), trainingSnapshot, healthKitExportedAt and healthKitExportFailureCount with the archived values (unconditional, not nil-coalesced).
True when start dates differ by < 1 s and end dates both differ by < 1 s (or are both nil).

branches.effect: returns whether both endDates are equal (true only when both nil); otherwise compares ends within 1 s

units.does: Fills weatherSnapshot, workoutFeeling, workoutFeelingNote, recognizedRouteName and dragFactor from the old metadata only where the rebuild left them nil.
Fills hrrSamples, liveMarkers, laps and strokeCount from the old metadata where the rebuild has nil.

When the rebuild has no samples, the archive has non-empty samples and the start is unchanged (±1 s): copies the archived per-second samples cut to offsets <= the rebuild's duration, re-derives healthKitHROffsets restricted to kept rows, and carries averageSplitSecPer500m only if no sample was cut.

branches.cond: rebuild already has samples, archive has none/empty, or start moved >= 1 s

branches.effect: uses archived.endDate; if both nil, end is nil
passes [] so the result is nil
true: averageSplitSecPer500m kept (rebuild value, else archived); false: left as rebuilt

units.does: Fills averagePowerWatts, normalizedPowerWatts, peakPowerWatts, powerTSS, intensityFactor, variabilityIndex and ftpAtTimeOfSession from the old metadata where the rebuild has nil.
